headline.title: More Google reviews than the 4 nearest aesthetic clinics we compared.
headline.detail: Modern You has 611 reviews at 5.0. That's a real advantage, but only if new clients who search find a page that turns that reputation into a booking.

summary: Modern You has 611 Google reviews at 5.0, and reviews praise a team that listens and never pushes unnecessary treatments. We compared you with the 4 nearest independent aesthetic clinics, and the gap is not quality but how easily new clients can find, trust and book you.
visibility: We compared Modern You with the 4 nearest independent aesthetic clinics on Google Maps (ratings, review counts and opening hours as shown today).
lead: 611 Google reviews at 5.0: more than 4 of the 4 aesthetic clinics nearby we compared.
Reviews praise a team that listens and never pushes unnecessary treatments.
lose: Dr West Aesthetic Medicine is open until 7pm on weekdays; you close at 6pm.
New clients who don't know you yet compare aesthetic clinics on a phone in seconds; without your own booking-ready page, your best reviews stay buried in the listing.

gaps.title: The comparison happens before anyone calls
gaps.detail: People choosing a clinic look at the map, the review count and a website, then book wherever it's easiest. Being the best isn't enough if it isn't visible.

gaps.title: Your strongest story is hidden
gaps.detail: Reviews praise a team that listens and never pushes unnecessary treatments. But someone new only sees a star rating, not why people love you.

gaps.title: Every appointment without a follow-up is a missed review
gaps.detail: Happy clients rarely leave a review unless someone asks at the right moment. That's how bigger aesthetic clinics pull ahead.

actions.title: Get a page that turns visitors into bookings
actions.why: Your reviews, treatments, hours and one-tap booking on one fast page for phones.

actions.title: Ask every client for a review automatically
actions.why: A short message after each appointment keeps you ahead of the aesthetic clinics nearby.

actions.title: Reply to every new review this week
actions.why: Doable today, without us: it shows new visitors a real person who cares, and they notice.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your treatments, team and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each appointment, so happy clients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Offers and win-back messages
plan.detail: Intro offers for new clients and gentle reminders for those who haven't booked in a while.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against the aesthetic clinics nearby, and what to do next.

scenario: Someone new to Downtown Burlington wants to book an appointment this week. On Sunday evening they open Maps, see a few aesthetic clinics and tap the one with the most reviews and an easy booking page. Modern You, with 611 reviews at 5.0, is close by, but they never get past the listing. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your regular clients keep coming back. New clients keep choosing whichever clinic looks easiest to book on their phone.
